source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **KROOT** and **VESPID STINGWINGS** units have **Harnessed Alien Instincts**: in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), the unit may pick one enemy unit it can see within 12", which is **prey-marked** for the rest of the phase; a **prey-marked** unit's detection range grows by 3".

Your **GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT** and **STEALTH BATTLESUITS** units have **Localised Stealth Projectors (Aura)**: a **KROOT** or **VESPID STINGWINGS** unit of yours within 6" of such a unit still counts as **hidden** after it has shot.

Carrying the **AUXILIARIES** tag, this detachment cannot be combined with another **AUXILIARIES** detachment.
